_note_bal: BAL WITHOUT A BALANCER BUILDER (2026-07-30). The real BAL market IS the Balancer 80/20 vault pool, but ADOPTION SCORES BREADTH, NOT MAGNITUDE: `net_better = n_wins + n_blind_spots`, and a win is a win at 1.24x or at 600x. Measured on the 6 BAL pairs in the ETH pool, routing BAL through USDT on UniV3 already clears the 500bps gate on all six (1.24x-1.36x where the champion's naive route quotes, unbounded where it does not) using the champion's OWN chain1 builder. A queryBatchSwap builder would deliver more wei and score EXACTLY THE SAME, while adding new calldata risk. Do not build it until the corpus or the scoring rule makes magnitude pay.

_note_v4: UNISWAP V4 ON L1 (2026-07-31, Opus escalation #6). kind='v4path' param is the V4 PathKey chain [[intermediateCurrency, fee, tickSpacing], ...] with hooks=0, executed as ONE UniversalRouter execute() carrying a single V4_SWAP (0x10) command whose action list is SETTLE(0x0b) / SWAP_EXACT_IN(0x07) / TAKE(0x0e) — the same actions and the same CONTRACT_BALANCE + OPEN_DELTA sentinels the champion's own cr_exotic_v4 emits. The ONLY difference is the router address: the champion hardcodes Base's UR 0x6ff5693b, which EXISTS on L1 but REVERTS (fork-measured), so L1 must use 0x66a9893cC07D91D95644AEDD05D03f95e1dBA8Af. _parked_atoken_why: Mechanism is FORK-PROVEN (100,000 aEthUSDC -> 52.127 aEthWETH, all 5 calls 0x1) but the PLAN is EXECUTOR-DEPENDENT: Aave withdraw(asset,amt,to) must deposit the underlying wherever the NEXT call pulls from, and Aave supply() pulls from msg.sender. Every champion plan is executor-AGNOSTIC (approve from msg.sender, output to contract_address), so this is the first plan where executor identity matters — and parity_bench executes from a separate EOA (anvil dev acct #0) while production's executor could not be determined from the SDK (execution is inside the JS sandbox). Unpreflightable => NOT SHIPPED (never ship an unpreflighted mechanism). Rows came back revert@0xE592427A, i.e. the cover FIRES correctly and only the fund-routing is wrong.
_atoken_path_forward: aToken->PLAIN (aBasWETH->USDC 36x, aBascbBTC->USDC 33x) is expressible EXECUTOR-AGNOSTICALLY with the Universal Router pattern the v4 pins already use: withdraw(asset, amt, to=UNIVERSAL_ROUTER) then UR.execute(V3_SWAP, payerIsUser=false, recipient=contract_address) — UR operates on PRE-TRANSFERRED funds, so no msg.sender dependency. aToken->aToken cannot be made agnostic because supply() always pulls from msg.sender. Do the aToken->plain direction FIRST.
